text:
maya: Heads-up — proposing a tenant id type swap (integer -> uuid) to support external federation. Target change window: Sun 2026-03-22 00:00 UTC (maintenance slot).

maya: Plan sketch: 1) add tenant_uuid NULLABLE, 2) backfill in batches, 3) dual-write (app writes both), 4) verify reads on uuid for canary, 5) migrate FKs to tenant_uuid via creation of new FK columns + index, 6) atomically swap PKs per-shard with advisory locks, 7) drop old tenant_id after traffic is fully on uuid. Aim to avoid a global exclusive DDL.

alan: +1 on avoiding global lock. question: how long do we expect the backfill to run? we should pick a conservative safety window.

kyle: Backfill estimate: ~5k rows/s per worker with current pool, about 18h full-table if run too fast. We should run batched worker with a rate limiter (100-200 qps total) and parallelize by shard. Prefer to finish pre-window and only do final delta during the window.

maya: Good. We'll pre-backfill >95% in the days before. During window we only do quiesce + final tail sync.

sasha: Service versioning: I'll pin api and background workers to v1.42 during the window so we can rollback without schema mismatch. After dual-write is live, we can rollout v1.43 which reads tenant_uuid by default.

maya: Example SQL for initial schema changes (non-blocking):
```sql
ALTER TABLE tenants ADD COLUMN tenant_uuid uuid NULL;
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_tenants_tenant_uuid ON tenants (tenant_uuid);
```

maya: Backfill job (pseudo):
```sql
UPDATE tenants SET tenant_uuid = gen_random_uuid() WHERE tenant_uuid IS NULL AND id BETWEEN $start AND $end;
-- run in 10k row chunks, sleep 50ms between chunks, track progress table
```

kyle: For referential integrity we should add tenant_uuid to FK tables as nullable first: add column + concurrent index + backfill via join to tenants. Then add FK constraint as NOT VALID and validate later.

alan: Quiesce plan: 5 min pre-window: flip feature flag to redirect new tenant creation to write both ids and pause non-essential background jobs. During window: acquire per-shard advisory locks to perform the PK swap. If any shard fails, release locks and abort remaining shards.

maya: Canary: run swap on shard 12 for 30m with 5% traffic routing to ensure read/write behavior is correct. If metrics OK, continue.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by maya for 2026-03-22 00:00 UTC — change-tenant-uuid-migration. Canary shard: 12. Maintainer: maya. Link: https://deploys.internal/r/1774081234

oncall-bot: Runbook reminder: monitor request_error_rate, db_deadlocks, replication_lag. If request_error_rate > 1% for 10m during swap -> trigger rollback hatch (instructions below). Alerts: #oncall and paged if severe.

alan: Rollback hatch (fast): 1) stop PK swap flow, 2) re-enable writes to old tenant_id only (disable dual-read of tenant_uuid in app), 3) revert any partial FK creates by dropping new FK columns created in the failed shard (safe because they were nullable), 4) release advisory locks.

kyle: Rollback SQL snippet for aborting a partially-applied shard swap:
```sql
-- example on shard N
SELECT pg_advisory_unlock(hashtext('tenant_swap_shard_'||N));
ALTER TABLE orders DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS tenant_uuid_search_tmp;
-- revert indexes added for the swap (concurrent where possible)
```

maya: I'll own coordination and trigger the deploy-bot window. alan you run the swap for shard ops, kyle you run backfill health checks and quick rollback steps, sasha you pin service versions then start canary rollout.

sasha: ack, pinning api & workers to v1.42 now. :thumbsup:

kyle: I'll push a flag into the backfill workers that limits to 200 qps and emits progress to /backfill/status. Will also run smoke queries against canary shard.

maya: Preflight checklist for Friday:
- pre-backfill >=95% done (kyle)
- integration tests reading tenant_uuid (sasha)
- db admin script reviewed + dry-run (alan)
- rollback procedures documented in ops runbook (maya)

alan: I'll do the dry-run tomorrow morning on staging and post timings.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-03-20 09:00 UTC — run preflight checklist.

oncall-bot: Logged runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/tenant-uuid-swap. If anything pages, use the rollback hatch steps.

maya: If no objections I'll lock the window and communicate to infra team by EOD. Otherwise call it out here.

alan: No objections. +1 from me.

sasha: No objections.

kyle: good to go from infra side.

maya: OK — locking window. Will post final runbook and timeline in #eng-releases 24h before. :eyes: :shipit:
